name: BoT-IoT: Internet of Things Botnet Attack Dataset
description: The BoT-IoT dataset was created by the Cyber Range Lab of UNSW Canberra Cyber to evaluate machine learning and deep learning anomaly detection models in Internet of Things (IoT) network environments. Simulating a realistic smart-home IoT testbed with simulated sensor nodes (Node-RED, MQTT, smart fridges, thermostats) and virtualized attacking machines, it captures over 72 million network flow records across benign conditions and malicious attacks, including DDoS, DoS, OS/service scan reconnaissance, keylogging, and data exfiltration. Provided in raw PCAPs, argus network flow files, and selected CSV subsets.
